async def act(page):
    import asyncio

    # Navigate directly to the new simple product creation page using a relative URL.
    await page.goto("/index.php/admin/catalog_product/new?type=simple")
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")

    # Helper: try to fill an input identified by one of several accessible labels
    async def try_fill(label_texts, value):
        for lbl in label_texts:
            try:
                locator = page.get_by_label(lbl)
                await locator.fill(str(value))
                return True
            except Exception:
                # If this label isn't present or fill fails, try next
                continue
        return False

    # Helper: try to select an option on a <select> identified by one of several labels
    async def try_select(label_texts, option_label=None, option_value=None):
        for lbl in label_texts:
            try:
                locator = page.get_by_label(lbl)
                if option_label is not None:
                    await locator.select_option(label=option_label)
                elif option_value is not None:
                    await locator.select_option(value=option_value)
                else:
                    # Nothing to select
                    return False
                return True
            except Exception:
                continue
        return False

    # Fill core product data
    await try_fill(["Name", "Product Name"], "Energy-Bulk Man Yoga Pant")
    await try_fill(["SKU"], "ENERGY-BULK-MAN-YOGA-PANT")
    await try_fill(["Price"], "69.99")

    # Weight can be required for simple products in some stores
    await try_fill(["Weight"], "1")

    # Status -> Enabled
    await try_select(["Status"], option_label="Enabled")

    # Visibility -> Catalog, Search (Magento label typically "Visibility")
    await try_select(["Visibility"], option_label="Catalog, Search")

    # Attributes: Color -> Yellow ; Size -> 38
    await try_select(["Color"], option_label="Yellow")
    await try_select(["Size"], option_label="38")

    # Open Inventory tab/section if present (try different accessible roles)
    inventory_clicked = False
    for role_name in [("tab", "Inventory"), ("link", "Inventory"), ("button", "Inventory")]:
        role, name = role_name
        try:
            await page.get_by_role(role, name=name).click()
            inventory_clicked = True
            break
        except Exception:
            continue

    if inventory_clicked:
        # small pause to let inventory fields render
        await asyncio.sleep(0.5)

    # Set Qty to 50
    await try_fill(["Qty", "Quantity", "Qty*"], "50")

    # Ensure Manage Stock = Yes and Stock Availability = In Stock so qty is respected
    await try_select(["Manage Stock"], option_label="Yes")
    await try_select(["Stock Availability", "Is in Stock", "In Stock"], option_label="In Stock")

    # Save the product. Try a few accessible button names. This is expected to navigate away,
    # so make it the last action.
    save_attempted = False
    for save_name in ["Save", "Save Product", "Save and Continue Edit"]:
        try:
            await page.get_by_role("button", name=save_name).click()
            save_attempted = True
            break
        except Exception:
            continue

    if not save_attempted:
        # As a last resort, try a button with a partial name match by calling get_by_role with substring match
        try:
            await page.get_by_role("button", name="Save").click()
            save_attempted = True
        except Exception:
            pass

    # Allow time for save to process if we clicked Save
    if save_attempted:
        await asyncio.sleep(2)
    else:
        raise Exception("Could not find a Save button to click")

    await try_select(["Visibility"], option_label="Catalog, Search")

    # Attributes: Color -> Yellow ; Size -> 38
    await try_select(["Color"], option_label="Yellow")
    await try_select(["Size"], option_label="38")

    # Open Inventory tab/section if present (try different accessible roles)
    inventory_clicked = False
    for role_name in [("tab", "Inventory"), ("link", "Inventory"), ("button", "Inventory")]:
        role, name = role_name
        try:
            await page.get_by_role(role, name=name).click()
            inventory_clicked = True
            break
        except Exception:
            continue

    if inventory_clicked:
        # small pause to let inventory fields render
        await asyncio.sleep(0.5)

    # Set Qty to 50
    await try_fill(["Qty", "Quantity", "Qty*"], "50")

    # Ensure Manage Stock = Yes and Stock Availability = In Stock so qty is respected
    await try_select(["Manage Stock"], option_label="Yes")
    await try_select(["Stock Availability", "Is in Stock", "In Stock"], option_label="In Stock")

    # Save the product. Try a few accessible button names. This is expected to navigate away,
    # so make it the last action.
    save_attempted = False
    for save_name in ["Save", "Save Product", "Save and Continue Edit"]:
        try:
            await page.get_by_role("button", name=save_name).click()
            save_attempted = True
            break
        except Exception:
            continue

    if not save_attempted:
        # As a last resort, try a button with a partial name match by calling get_by_role with substring match
        try:
            await page.get_by_role("button", name="Save").click()
            save_attempted = True
        except Exception:
            pass

    # Allow time for save to process if we clicked Save
    if save_attempted:
        await asyncio.sleep(2)
    else:
        raise Exception("Could not find a Save button to click")
